description: Ten route-linked official-manager parking/access research checkpoints. Static sources document identity, trailheads, seasonal restrictions; they are NOT current winter road/parking access checks.
operationalEvidencePolicy: No live winter plowing, road access, or trail-open assertion can be inferred from a static webpage, historical PDF, DNR point, NPS trailhead GPS, or fetch timestamp. Positive results require dated manager operational observations with route-specific details.

checkpoints.title: Vasa Pathway — Bartlett Road
checkpoints.sourceMeaning: DNR lists 4450 Bartlett Road as pathway parking and the snowshoe entrance opposite the grooming barn. No dated winter lot clearance or vehicle entrance coordinate established.
checkpoints.roadHint: Bartlett Road from Bunker Hill Road
checkpoints.restriction: Do not use the groomed classic ski track; snowshoe trail is separately blazed.
checkpoints.question: Is the Bartlett Road snowshoe lot plowed, open to passenger cars and accessible from Bunker Hill Road today?

checkpoints.title: Hartwick Pines — Old Growth/Mertz access
checkpoints.sourceMeaning: DNR lists 3612 State Park Drive as the park address, Old Growth access at the visitor center and an indefinite closure of Au Sable River bridge segments. Address is not a certified winter lot.
checkpoints.parkingHint: 3612 State Park Dr, Grayling, MI 49738 (park address only)
checkpoints.restriction: Au Sable River bridge-section indefinite closure; do not treat it as a complete loop.
checkpoints.question: Which Old Growth/Mertz parking lot and access road are plowed, and what signed closures remain?

checkpoints.title: Tahquamenon — Upper Falls day use
checkpoints.sourceMeaning: DNR describes Upper Falls day-use snowshoe/packed walking access. Historical 2020 winter map portrays plowed roads, not observed 2026–27 plowing.
checkpoints.parkingHint: Upper Falls day-use area (exact winter lot unconfirmed)
checkpoints.roadHint: M-123 and Upper Falls entrance road
checkpoints.restriction: Upper Falls Lantern/Giant Pines loops are ski trails, not snowshoe circuits; stay off groomed tracks.
checkpoints.question: Which Upper Falls lot and walking/snowshoe entry are plowed and legally open this week?

checkpoints.title: Tahquamenon — Lower Falls day use
checkpoints.sourceMeaning: Historical DNR winter map marks Lower Falls roads and walking routes as plowed and two snowshoe loops. Not proof of this season's actual maintenance.
checkpoints.parkingHint: Lower Falls day-use area (separate from year-round campground)
checkpoints.roadHint: M-123 and Lower Falls entrance road
checkpoints.restriction: Trail connecting Upper and Lower Falls is not maintained in winter.
checkpoints.question: Is the Lower Falls day-use lot plowed, and are Green and Blue loops open from that entrance?

checkpoints.title: Spring Brook Pathway
checkpoints.sourceMeaning: DNR maps one pathway reference at 45.217643,-84.811492; the point is not a lot or approved winter vehicle access.
checkpoints.parkingHint: No independently verified winter lot address
checkpoints.restriction: Ungroomed shared ski/snowshoe pathway; motor-road plowing unknown.
checkpoints.question: What exact parking entrance serves the two winter loops, and is its access road plowed?

checkpoints.title: Sleeping Bear — Alligator Hill Stocking trailhead
checkpoints.sourceMeaning: NPS provides Stocking Drive trailhead GPS and a parking amenity; site does not report current snow clearance of its approach or the lot.
checkpoints.parkingHint: Stocking Drive trailhead, GPS 44.8896,-86.0215 (NPS trailhead reference, not winter-cleared lot)
checkpoints.roadHint: Stocking Drive access; NOT Pierce Stocking Scenic Drive interior
checkpoints.restriction: Ski trail Dec 1–Mar 31; pets prohibited, snowshoes remain off groomed ski tracks.
checkpoints.question: Is Stocking Drive trailhead lot and approach road plowed and is the cross-country ski lane marked for snowshoers?

checkpoints.title: Sleeping Bear — Old Indian Trail
checkpoints.sourceMeaning: NPS publishes trailhead reference GPS 44.7028,-86.185, not season-current clearance or a plowed parking designation.
checkpoints.parkingHint: Old Indian trailhead NPS GPS (not certified parking)
checkpoints.roadHint: Off M-22, south end of park; verify winter approach
checkpoints.restriction: Pets prohibited Dec 1–Mar 31; do not snowshoe in groomed classic ski tracks.
checkpoints.question: Is the Old Indian trailhead lot plowed with vehicle access and are both 2.3-mile loops open?

checkpoints.title: Sleeping Bear — Windy Moraine
checkpoints.sourceMeaning: NPS describes Windy Moraine trailhead on Welch Road east of M-109 and 1.5-mile trail, without specific 2026–27 parking maintenance.
checkpoints.parkingHint: Welch Road east of M-109 (trailhead location, not confirmed plowed lot)
checkpoints.restriction: Advanced winter ski use, stay off groomed tracks; pets restricted Dec 1–Mar 31.
checkpoints.question: Is Welch Road maintained to the Windy Moraine trailhead and is a designated winter lot plowed?

checkpoints.title: Sleeping Bear — Good Harbor Bay
checkpoints.sourceMeaning: NPS identifies trailhead GPS at 44.938,-85.8553 and low wetland bridge, but not the plowing of Lake Michigan Road or parking.
checkpoints.parkingHint: Good Harbor Bay trailhead, NPS GPS 44.938,-85.8553 (not certified cleared)
checkpoints.roadHint: Lake Michigan Road from County Road 669
checkpoints.restriction: Wetland bridge can be icy; pets prohibited Dec 1–Mar 31.
checkpoints.question: Is Lake Michigan Road plowed to this picnic/trailhead area and is the parking lot open for snowshoe use?

checkpoints.title: Bay City — Tobico Marsh and Lagoon
checkpoints.sourceMeaning: DNR lists the park road address and Tobico Marsh trail uses; multiple access points exist. The park address does not resolve a plowed marsh trailhead.
checkpoints.parkingHint: 3582 State Park Dr, Bay City, MI 48706 (main park address, not a selected Tobico trailhead)
checkpoints.roadHint: State Park Drive; wetland approaches differ
checkpoints.restriction: Separate marsh/lagoon/Andersen entries and icy wetland boardwalk sections require their own trail-specific inspection.
checkpoints.question: Which Tobico Marsh/lagoon/Andersen trail entrance is open and which lot is actually plowed?
